chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ja'far b. Muhammad b. Malik. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Zayd narrated to me. He said: Abu Ahmad Muhammad b. Ziyad narrated to us. He said: Ziyad b. al-Mundhir narrated to us from Sa'id b. Jubayr from Ibn 'Abbas. He said:

'Ali (peace be upon him) said to the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family): O Messenger of God, surely you love 'Aqil? He said: Yes, by God! I love him with two loves: a love for him, and a love for Abu Talib's love for him. And surely his son shall be killed in the love of your son. The eyes of the believers shall shed tears over him, and the angels made proximate shall pray over him.
Then the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) wept until his tears flowed onto his chest. Then he said: To God I complain of what my progeny shall encounter after me.

key_terms.الملائكة المقربون: the angels made proximate — the highest-ranking angels closest to God
key_terms.حبين: two loves — the Prophet's dual motivation for loving 'Aqil
key_terms.عترتي: 'itrati — my progeny/family, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.عقيل: 'Aqil b. Abu Talib — brother of Imam Ali, uncle figure in the Hashimite family

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about 'Aqil and the martyrdom of his son?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated through Ibn 'Abbas, Imam Ali asks the Prophet about his love for 'Aqil b. Abu Talib, and the Prophet reveals he loves 'Aqil with a double love — for 'Aqil himself and for Abu Talib's love for him. The Prophet then prophesies that 'Aqil's son (Muslim b. 'Aqil) will be martyred for the sake of Ali's son (Imam Husayn), foretelling the events leading to Karbala. The Prophet weeps and laments what his family will face after him.
